channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Trump’s Justice Dept. Targets Smaller Fraud Cases
item.description: As the Trump administration drops charges against corporations and the wealthy, it is also taking aim at small-scale fraud cases, including against the operator of a weathered food truck in California.

item.title: NPR: From Europe to Asia, floods to heatwaves, world experiences weather shocks
item.description: At least eight people died in Japan as heavy rains flooded roads and disrupted traffic while firefighters from Britain to France and Croatia struggled to contain blazes in Europe's fifth heatwave this summer

item.title: BBC News: Farage's by-election victory won't stop questions about finances
item.description: Nigel Farage triggered the Clacton by-election and the result was predictable - so what did he achieve?

item.title: The Guardian: ‘It was lonely being a young queer artist’: Sam Smith on finding health, happiness – and their hazel-eyed fiance
item.description: On their new album, Smith is subverting their singer-songwriter roots to tell a queer love story. They talk about their shifting fanbase, the nasty undercurrents of fame – and finding sanctuary in New York City Sam Smith…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Scrutiny over Farage’s finances has ‘hurt Reform UK support’
item.description: Scrutiny over Farage’s finances has ‘hurt Reform UK support’

item.title: Ars Technica: Organic-looking brake assemblies debut on new Czinger 21C Spyder
item.description: Czinger used topological design and additive manufacturing to make the brakes.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: 5 Weird Tricks for Having a Brain
item.description: From the multibrained octopus to the bitty brain organoid, we’re all just inference engines making flawed bets on the future. Here are the five insights your brain will need to survive.

item.title: WIRED Science: The Real Reason Data Center Gas Power Plants Are So Dirty
item.description: A massive new gas plant in Texas will be built with much less efficient technology than regular gas plants. It’s far from the only data center power project to rely on dirty turbines.

item.title: WIRED Business: The Safety Reckoning Inside OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI’s rogue agent hack was a watershed moment for AI safety and cybersecurity. It also sparked internal questions about the culture that led to it.

item.title: The New Yorker: Is D.N.C. Chair the Worst Job in Washington?
item.description: The organization is holding its annual summer meeting, and onlookers are calling for the head of its leader, Ken Martin. Then again, the Democrats are always doing that kind of thing.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: The Retrievals Is Becoming a Netflix Series
item.description: Emilia Jones is set to star.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Year-Round Curbside Dining Is Coming Back
item.description: City Council approves shivery pizza for all.
